item.title: Tell Murph your VO2 max
item.summary: Some wearables, like WHOOP, keep VO2 max in their own app. Text Murph the number or a screenshot and it saves it, so it shows with your numbers and on your game board.
item.details: Murph only says it saved your VO2 max after the save goes through. The board shows the number you told Murph; the device name stays private to you.
